sukuna.mech.heat.desc: Using the same basic technique repeatedly lowers its damage by 12% per repeat, down to 40%. Using a different technique or waiting 8 seconds resets it.
sukuna.mech.black_flash.desc: After a Black Flash attempt you hear three beats. Press any technique key or LMB on the third beat (within 0.1 s) for a perfect flash: bonus damage, a growing streak and the Zone for 10 seconds. In the Zone further flashes refund most of their cooldowns. A miss gives a weak flash and ends the streak.

sukuna.mech.domain_meter.desc: Fills by dealing and taking damage and by kills. A real domain needs 100% and spends all of it. At 100% it also allows an instant awakening; below 40% health a one-time emergency awakening costs 50%.
sukuna.mech.m1.desc: Left click with an empty hand (Maki: with a weapon) every 0.5 seconds for a light strike.
sukuna.mech.convergence.desc: Standing still for 2 seconds charges Convergence: your next two blood techniques deal 1.5x damage.
